# tools/render/reference — FORMAT reference only

**Do not edit these files.** They are the **historical record of class tests actually given** —
an imported reference corpus, not live templates (Principal ruling 2026-08-09, CD-023).

| File | Status |
|---|---|
| `C5_Bangla_ClassTest_Ch19.md` | FORMAT reference only |
| `C5_Bangla_ClassTest_Ch20.md` | FORMAT reference only |

## ⚠ Never copy the time line

Both papers read **`সময়: ৪৫ মিনিট`**. That is **superseded by the 35-minute rule** — 35 minutes
standard for a 25-mark class test, 30 permitted, 35 maximum (**CD-021**). The generator's
`--duration-min` config default of 35 is the living rule; it is enforced and rejects anything
outside 30–35.

**These files teach structure, not time.** Copy the question shape, the domain table, the marking
guidance and the teacher-section layout. Never carry the duration line across.

They also predate the no-section-letter convention and read `৩ক` / `৩খ` (CR-001). Same principle:
the header is generated from `--ct-number`, not copied from here.
